OUR SERVICES

Ready to rent or sell.

Cleaning, minor repairs and professional property photography—all coordinated in one place.

Services, pricing and timing are subject to the quote agreed by both parties for each property.

End-of-lease cleaning

Cleaning for the end of a tenancy, with the scope confirmed for each property.

  • Kitchen, oven and rangehood
  • Bathrooms and laundry
  • Floors and general interior cleaning
  • Cupboards and wardrobes
  • Internal windows and accessible tracks

Minor repairs and touch-ups

Minor repairs and general upkeep for everyday wear and tear during and between tenancies.

  • Wall patching and paint touch-ups
  • Door handles, hinges and cupboard fittings
  • Blinds and flyscreen repairs
  • Minor silicone and grout touch-ups
  • Garden tidying and outdoor maintenance

Silicone and grout touch-ups are cosmetic only; waterproofing and leak repairs are excluded.

Specialist services

Specialist services can be arranged separately where required.

  • Professional property photography
  • Carpet steam cleaning
  • Upholstery cleaning
  • Pressure cleaning
  • Additional window cleaning
  • Surface mould cleaning
